title: RecursiveRelativeErrorSmoothConvex.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable convex minimization on a real Hilbert space E. For every x,y, f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩ ≤ f(y) ≤ f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩+(L/2)‖y−x‖². A global minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x₀−x⋆‖≤R; strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: inexact_gradient
oracle.details: One oracle accepts x∈E and returns g∈E satisfying ‖g−∇f(x)‖≤α‖∇f(x)‖ for every history, query, and seed. Function values are not supplied. Answers may depend on the full history, and oracle seeds may be dependent.

distinctive_assumptions.label: biased_oracle
distinctive_assumptions.details: No unbiasedness or mean-zero condition is imposed; arbitrary bias is permitted within the pointwise relative-error bound.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: The error bound is pointwise relative to the true gradient norm. With Q=2+LR²/ε, validity requires 0≤α<1 and α≤exp(−8(1+√log Q))/100.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is an arbitrary complete real inner-product space, with no finite-dimensional restriction. E, L, x₀, α, R, and ε are public; L>0, R≥0, and ε>0. The objective and its minimizer are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvex.lean: Public; LongTails/Setups/RelativeErrorSmoothConvex.lean: Public, spec.Params, spec.publicInput, spec.Instance, and spec.valid.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a point x∈E satisfying f(x)−f(x⋆)≤ε for a global minimizer x⋆. There is no requirement that the output be a queried point.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the product of the algorithm-seed law and oracle-seed law, after execution with the supplied fixed oracle-call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines smooth convex Hilbert-space optimization with arbitrary pointwise relative gradient errors and an accuracy-dependent exponential restriction on their magnitude. Repository implementations and proofs were not inspected; no qualifying reference is a search outcome, not a novelty claim.

descriptionHtml:
Small Relative Error Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing a differentiable convex function f:E→R on a real Hilbert space E. The function is L-smooth, with L>0, and a given point x0∈E lies within distance R≥0 of a global minimizer x⋆. At x, the oracle returns a vector g satisfying ∥g−∇f(x)∥≤α∥∇f(x)∥, where 0≤α<1 and α≤exp⁡(−8(1+log⁡(2+LR2/ε)))/100. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈E satisfying f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤ε almost surely under P, the joint law of algorithm and oracle randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E. The algorithm receives E, L, x0, α, R, and ε.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E. For every x,y∈E, f(y)≥f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩,f(y)≤f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩+L2∥y−x∥2.

Assumption 2 (Initial distance). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Assumption 3 (Uniform relative oracle error). Queries may be made at any point of E. The relative error bound stated above holds for every query, every finite query–reply history, and every realization of the oracle randomness. The reply may depend on that history, and oracle randomness may be dependent across calls. Algorithm randomness is independent of oracle randomness.

After the allotted oracle calls, the output must satisfy f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤εP-a.s. The minimizer x⋆ is fixed independently of the randomness.

comparisonHtml:
On a real Hilbert space, f is differentiable and satisfies 0≤f(y)−f(x)−⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩≤L∥y−x∥2/2. A minimizer x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R, with L>0, R≥0, ε>0. Every oracle reply obeys ∥g−∇f(x)∥≤α∥∇f(x)∥, where 0≤α≤e−8(1+log⁡(2+LR2/ε))/100. The target is f(xout)−f(x⋆)≤ε for every admissible reply sequence. The setup supplies L,α,R,ε,x0 and imposes no algorithm restriction.

import LongTails.Setups.RelativeErrorSmoothConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

namespace LongTails.Setups.RecursiveRelativeErrorSmoothConvex

abbrev Public := RelativeErrorSmoothConvex.Public

abbrev spec : OracleTemplate.Setup :=
  { RelativeErrorSmoothConvex.spec with
    valid := fun p => RelativeErrorSmoothConvex.spec.valid p ∧
      p.α ≤ Real.exp (-8 * (1 + Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 + p.L * p.R ^ 2 / p.ε)))) / 100 }

end LongTails.Setups.RecursiveRelativeErrorSmoothConvex
